title: Trans-Iranian Railway
standfirst: 1,394 km standard-gauge line opened fully in 1938.

body.text: Connects the Caspian Sea in the north to the Persian Gulf in the south; opened fully in 1938[@unesco1585].
Inscribed on the World Heritage List on 25 July 2021[@unesco1585].
Built during Reza Shah's reign as part of the expansion of roads, railways and state factories[@loc15].
